caption: The drawing consists of an ornamental, symmetrical design centered on a rectangular sheet with a beige background. The main motif is an oval shape, bordered by small regularly spaced black dots, containing abstract floral and leaf-like elements in shades of black, grey, and muted orange. Additional stylized floral and leaf forms extend above and below the oval, and smaller scattered elements mirror these on both sides, creating a balanced composition. The orange elements are selectively placed among the predominantly black and grey forms, contributing to the decorative pattern. The background of the main design is light grey, providing contrast to the colored motifs. The motif occupies most of the central area within a rectangular border, leaving a wide margin on the surrounding paper.
title: Detail of Stencilled Wall
